messages.subject: geom_bar + geom_abline
parts:
> dput(head(txn))
structure(list(Location = c("Worldpoints", "Vin Club", "Paragon",
"Vin Club", "Paragon", "Vonage"), Amount = c(1901.53, 12, 15,
25, 15, 32.52), Done_on = structure(c(1327182558, 1327193199,
1327498496, 1327526633, 1327672242, 1327732589), class = c("POSIXct",
"POSIXt")), Human.readable.Date = c(" 21-Jan-2012 21:49:52",
" 22-Jan-2012 00:46:56", " 25-Jan-2012 13:34:56", " 25-Jan-2012 21:24:16",
" 27-Jan-2012 13:49:52", " 28-Jan-2012 06:36:48")), .Names = c("Location",
"Amount", "Done_on", "Human.readable.Date"), row.names = c(NA,
6L), class = "data.frame")
> require(ggplot2)
> ggplot(txn, aes(x=Done_on, Weight=Amount)) + geom_bar() + theme_bw() + geom_abline(intercept=min(as.numeric(txn$Done_on)), slope=1);
The plot is available at http://d8u.us/~hdiwan/test_bar.png and the abline isn't visible/not working. What I'd like to see is the line joining the peaks of the bar plot. Many thanks! -- H
